title: Open reduction and actual reconstruction unit at a normalized total limit
statement: For a prime l and finite coefficient field E, fix Operations o and a RealizationModel m (def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge). For every quasi-compact open immersion j:U->V of schemes and a strict system N on U with Good N and Good(o.shriek(j)(N)) (def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain), put K=L_U(N). Then the actual reconstruction unit at ringedOpen(j)(K) is invertible, and the actual open-adjunction mate m.openReduction(j)(K) is invertible. No realization isomorphism or normalization equation is asserted. There is no finite-field or invertibility-of-l hypothesis; the input and output Good conditions are exactly those of the ambient theorem.

proof.text: The ordinary open slice extension commutes with quotient-tensor reduction. Its direct-sum formula gives an inverse, including the empty sum. Take its adjunction mate under ordinary open restriction. The identity-section ordinary limit/direct-image comparison determining m has this restriction comparison as its left-adjoint conjugate.

proof.text: Use m.model on flat-term K-flat representatives to identify m.reductionPull with the localized ordinary restriction comparison, then take open mates. Localize the ordinary inverse to prove invertibility of m.openReduction at K. This is the same argument as integralOpenMateNormalization, applied at the normalized total limit without its unnecessary geometric input restrictions.

proof.text: Normalized reconstruction makes L_U(N) complete. Exact quasi-compact open slice extension preserves countable products and the uniformizer scalar, so its termwise functor preserves the principal-completion triangle and its unit. Thus it preserves the quotient-tower completeness predicate. Apply normalized reconstruction on V to make the actual unit at that complete extension invertible. This coefficient-linear argument works independently of the scheme characteristic.

lean.statement:
theorem integralOpenReductionNormalizedLimit (o : Operations l E)
    (m : RealizationModel l E o) {U V : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] (N : System l E U)
    (hN : Good l E U N)
    (hJ : Good l E V ((Operations.shriek l E o j).obj N)) :
    IsIso ((calculus l E V).adjunction.unit.app
      ((ringedOpen l E j).obj ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E U).obj N))) ∧
      IsIso ((m.openReduction l E j).app ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E U).obj N))
